messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: pattern across recent postmortems — post-deploy token validation flaps and missing audit writes during service-account rotations. Want owners, short deadlines, and quick mitigations so this doesn't recur.

Alex Kim: Can you paste a representative log line we can bake into a smoke test?

Maya Chen: Example from incident bundle:
```
ERROR authz token_validation: 'kid' not found in jwks, verified=false, req=tx-11a
```

Jordan Patel: Also observed envoy cache-miss spikes ~20-40s after deploys. Hypothesis: stale JWKs / delayed key-cache invalidation.

Sasha R.: Audit sink returned 503 during one rotation; rotation handler used async fire-and-forget so the audit never persisted. We should switch to write-with-ack + retries or rollback on persistent failure.

Leo Ortiz: Proposed owners & due dates:
- Alex Kim — post-deploy token smoke + CI gating (due 2026-05-12)
- Sasha R. — rotation flow: sync write + retry + tests (due 2026-05-19)
- Jordan Patel — orphaned-creds sweep job + runbook (due 2026-05-26)
- Leo Ortiz — authz trend dashboard + weekly anomaly alert (due 2026-05-05)
Please ack and we'll add to the remediation tracker.

Alex Kim: ack. I'll add a tiny curl-based smoke to infra/ci and open a PR linking the postmortem.

Sasha R.: ack. I'll implement write-with-ack and exponential retry; include integration test that simulates sink errors.

Jordan Patel: ack. I'll draft the runbook "Detecting & remediating orphaned creds" and propose a k8s cron job to sweep stale tokens.
